## 🎉 Congratulations! You've completed the React Foundations track!

<div align="center">

### 🌟 You built a fully functional React SPA from scratch! 🌟

</div>

Over 7 steps you learned:

| ✅ | Topic | Concept |
|---|-------|---------|
| 1 | Tooling | npm, package.json, Vite, React DevTools |
| 2 | JSX & Components | JSX rules, functional components, props |
| 3 | State & Events | `useState`, `onClick`, conditional rendering |
| 4 | Lists & Forms | `.map()` with keys, controlled inputs, `preventDefault` |
| 5 | useEffect & Fetch | Dependency array, async/await, native `fetch` |
| 6 | API Integration | Error handling, loading states, REST endpoints |
| 7 | Routing | React Router, `<Link>`, `useParams` |

### 🚀 What's Next?

The complete reference app is already in your repo at `src/react-app/` — it connects to the Python backend and shows all these concepts working together. Read through it and compare it to your exercise solutions.

**Keep building:**

- Style the app with a CSS framework like Tailwind or Chakra UI
